source.citation: Smout, B., 2025, Digital Data of Structural Contours from Previously Published USGS Mississippi Embayment Studies: U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P14BV2PI
source.crs: shapefile NAD_1983_Contiguous_USA_Albers (lat. of origin 23, std. parallels 29.5/45.5, CM -96) reprojected to NAD83 geographic (EPSG:4269)
source.units: m: elevation of the surface in metres relative to sea level (negative = below); ft original
source.thinning: vertices closer than 400 m along a line dropped; clipped to lon -91.6..-87.3, lat 34.3..37.8
source.unitCorrection: DAS06 (Dart 1995, MF-2284) lines in IsoValueLines_TopPaleozoic: the release's Value_ft column holds Dart's contour labels, which are in METRES; Value_m is an erroneous re-conversion. Evidence (2026-09-07): at 648 vertices where Dart and Cushing (DAS07) contours lie within 1.5 km of each other, median |Value_ft - Cushing metres| = 18 m versus |Value_m - Cushing metres| = 290 m; Memphis reads -900 vs Cushing -914; Dyersburg -700 vs -671; Union City -500 vs -488. Field m below carries the corrected value for DAS06; m_release preserves the original.

dataSources.DAS06: Dart, R.L., 1995, Maps of upper Mississippi embayment Paleozoic and Precambrian rocks, USGS Miscellaneous Field Studies Map MF-2284, doi:10.3133/mf2284
dataSources.DAS07: Cushing, E.M., Boswell, E.H., and Hosman, R.L., 1964, General geology of the Mississippi embayment, USGS Professional Paper 448-B
